Name: Slightly More Vanilla RRRR Wizard
Author: lillifer
Description:
A slightly modified version of Jello's RRRR Wizard portraits made to look a little bit more vanilla, uploaded with permission. I changed these files for personal use and figured I would upload in case anyone else is interested.

To install:
Unzip and drop the "assets" folder directly into [CP]Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard, overwrite when asked.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and drop the assets folder directly into [CP]Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard, overwrite when asked.
